“Three or four years ago, we were super excited when our [AI] models could solve eighth-grade math problems,” Jeff Dean, chief scientist, Google DeepMind and Google Research, said during a panel discussion at Nvidia’s GTC developer show last week.

description:
A new infostealer is bypassing Chrome’s Application-Bound Encryption (ABE), using a debugger-based technique that researchers say hasn’t been observed in the wild.

Called “VoidStealer,” the stealer appears to have found a way around ABE, introduced in Chrome 127 in 2024, a security control that locks sensitive browser data, such as passwords and cookies, behind stronger encryption and ties decryption to a privileged system service.

title: Chrome encryption bypass discovered: New malware steals passwords and cookies

description:
Finding the right time for everybody to meet is a big challenge in work life. Simply throwing out a suggested meeting time in email — “Is everyone free on Thursday at 11am EST?” — often leads to multiple rounds of “I can’t make it then. How about Wednesday at 2pm?” follow-ups.

There’s a better way. The Scheduling Assistant in Microsoft Outlook and Teams can scan your co-workers’ calendars and show you in a grid the days and times when each co-worker is busy or free. You just select a time slot when everybody’s schedule is open for your meeting.

title: How to check your co-workers’ schedules in Outlook and Teams
